data.description:
## Context / Problem
The completion-verifier LLM runs even when the ticket's own Acceptance Criteria block still contains unchecked '- [ ]' items — a deterministic fail-fast condition. Backtest: 0/823 verifier-passed closes had unchecked boxes, so the precheck adds no false rejections; check-ac exists but only as a readiness scorer, absent from the close path.

## Approach
In the close transition path (before the LLM verifier dispatch), parse the ticket description's '## Acceptance Criteria' section; if any '- [ ]' checkbox remains unchecked, fail the close deterministically with a teaching message (check the box after satisfying it, or edit the AC with justification) — same style as existing DET short-circuits. Exempt classes that skip the verifier today (duplicate/not_a_bug/escalated via replacement-link precheck) are untouched: the precheck runs only where the verifier would run.

## Scope
- src/rebar/_commands/transition_close.py (precheck family, alongside _completion_precheck)
- tests for the close path

## Testing
Happy: all boxes checked -> close proceeds to verifier. Unchecked box -> exit non-zero pre-LLM with the teaching message. Non-completion classes (duplicate etc.) bypass unchanged. Description without checkbox syntax -> precheck passes (prose AC remains legal).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Close on a ticket with any unchecked '- [ ]' AC item fails deterministically BEFORE any LLM call, with remediation guidance.
- [ ] Prose-only AC (no checkboxes) and non-completion close classes are unaffected.
- [ ] Backtest property preserved: historical verifier-passed closes would all still pass (0 FP).
- [ ] Tests cover checked, unchecked, prose-only, and exempt-class paths.
data.title: AC-checkbox completeness precheck at close (deterministic, pre-LLM)
